Forever Name Forge

Character and guild names for every race and class in WoW Forever. Lore-true names, hard-hitting compounds, epic titles, memes, and twists on film, history and pop culture, all fitted to your race and class.

Name rules: first and last name up to 12 letters each, letters only. Only the full name has to be unique in your region, so a taken first name can still work with a new surname.
1,900 hand-picked names plus endless generated ones.
